basis: renders role="list" with role="listitem" rows; the virtualized DOM reports aria-setsize/aria-posinset on every painted row, and the active row is the single roving tab stop.

harness.because: the harness spec drives the real component: focus the first row, rove with arrow keys, jump with Home/End, and activate with Enter — the windowed DOM's interaction contract, provable only in a browser

interaction.basis: a long list managed as one widget: arrow keys/Home/End/PageUp/PageDown move the active row across the full set — even rows not yet painted — and Enter/Space activates it.
